question: Can the accepted modular harness carry one unchanged question through 64 logical pocket i, keep only supported and safe evidence, and let Qwen3-1.7B produce a correct final answer across all 30 frozen tasks?
plain_language_question: Can the whole machine find the right helpers, keep their proof, hide secrets, and give one useful answer without making things up?

jobs: turn one exact safe source fragment into one short readable claim
turn validated evidence piles into one final answer

fixed_modules.job: Keep the user's question byte-for-byte and record its SHA-256.
Ask the 16 best matching public capability cards.
Each selected pocket i offers at most one owner-approved local record.
Send only the safe excerpt; synthetic canaries must never leave their owner.
Choose TAKE, NOT SURE, or DROP for relevance only.
Ordinary code proves the exact fragment and source version.
Check whether the exact fragment supports the short claim.
Use the latest item in a lineage and keep older items as history.
Keep distinct supported versions separate while collapsing true paraphrases.
Qwen3-1.7B writes only from validated piles; an empty board gets a fixed answer.

locked_success_gates.complete_correct_final_answers: at least 24 of 30 questions by owner semantic review

boundaries: This is a synthetic development experiment, not evidence from real users or real private memories.
The 64 pocket i are logical actors on one yukabox, not 64 physical devices.
Qwen3-1.7B does not replace the reranker, source checker, or NLI checker.
A one-item knowledge lineage exercises the storage contract but does not prove revision handling at scale.
The application will not be started until the owner reviews this result.
